Overall, most of the results are in line with our hypotheses based on the literature but some of them reflect the unique aspect of ISD in China and meanwhile reveal the existence of many problems.

articleTitle: Research on the Evaluation of Information Superiority in Near Space Information System
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In informational war, information has become the dominant factor of battlefield. It is the key of winning a battle obtaining information superiority. To meet the characteristic of near space information system, fix an information superiority evaluation method by using the contrast of perceptive situational quality. The measurement of information superiority is presented with three guidelines, which are completeness, accuracy, and timeliness. A quantificational method to describe the information superiority of near space information system is proposed, and the quantificational relationship between information superiority and information dominance is showed. All of the studies are basic to establish the evaluation model of information superiority and simulate the systematic countermine.

articleTitle: A New Form of the Numerical Dispersion Relation of ADI-FDTD for the 3D Maxwell's Equations
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, a new form of the numerical dispersion relation of the alternating direction implicit finite difference time domain (ADI-FDTD) method for the 3D Maxwell equations is derived from the equivalent form of ADI-FDTD. It is shown that this new form is simpler than the original one and easy to be used to make further analysis. By comparison with the numerical dispersion relations of the Crank-Nicolson (CN) FDTD scheme and the FDTD scheme it is shown that the numerical dispersion relation of ADI-FDTD is much more closer to that of CN-FDTD than to that of FDTD. The relation between the new form and the original form of the numerical dispersion relation of ADI-FDTD is also given that they are equivalent to each other.

articleTitle: Power-Effective in Multi-Hop Relay Network Based on Wireless Broadband Systems
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Multi-hop relaying is an important concept in future generation wireless networks. It can address the inherent problems of limited capacity and coverage in cellular networks. However, most existing multi-hop relaying architectures waste energy. In this paper, our goal is to find a power-effective multihop relaying architecture, since the problem of coverage extension may occur in the given target service area where users' traffic density is relatively low or moderate, this paper introduces several popular topologies and the corresponding coverage extension methods for each case. Further, sets up the optimized mathematical model and obtain the simulation results which show that Type-D is the best topology which consumes less power than Type-A, Type-B and Type-C.

articleTitle: An Improved Guard Channel Algorithm in Cognitive Radio System
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Cognitive radio technology has arisen as a hot topic in wireless communication in recent years. Special spectrum allocation algorithms are essential to adapt to the time-space varying characteristics of wireless spectrum in cognitive networks. In this paper, we study and simulate the guard channel policy proposed by Huang Zhen, etc. We find that the blocking probability of secondary users is relatively high and channel utilization is relatively low. In view of the above two points, we propose an improved algorithm to improve the performance. The simulation results show that both the blocking probability and channel utilization are improved.

articleTitle: Study and Implementation of Distributed Intrusion Detection System Based on Anycast Service
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Anycast is a new characteristic of Ipv6 and it has played an important role in many application fields. Therefore, in order to ensure that Anycast service can be performed in security and develop healthily this paper has proposed a distributed intrusion detection system model based on Anycast service. This distributed intrusion detection system model effectively combines the host intrusion detection and network intrusion detection and improves the Anycast servers' ability to defend against intrusion attacks, and in the meanwhile it can also ensure that Anycast service can be performed in security.

articleTitle: Frequency Points Allocation Algorithm in Cluster-Based Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Characteristics of wireless sensor network are mainly featured in three aspects such as numerous nodes and large-scale networks and restricted operation ability. A frequency points allocation algorithm is proposed in order to decrease collision probability with increasing traffic load in this paper. Based on the coloring, nodes with different frequency points in different cluster can communicate with each other to reduce collision probability and avoid disturbance among clusters, especially for hidden-terminal problem by distributed control mode and power control. Test results of frequency points allocation in three power of ZigBee 2.4G show that it can reach the designed goal and costs less.

articleTitle: An Accurate Expression of Capacity for Multi-User MIMO Systems with Zero-Forcing Receiver
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In multi-user MIMO broadcast systems, utilize the simple zero-forcing receiver on top of the TDMA scheduling can obtain good performance. In , a TDMA scheduling strategy which based on the maximum capacity criterion has been proposed, but the author does not analysis the system performance theoretically for arbitrary finite number of users. In this paper, we focus on the 2times2 multi-user MIMO broadcast scenario and give an approximate closed-form expression for the scheduling strategy which proposed. Simulation results show that the expression we deduced can accurate characterize the system capacity under different SNR regions for arbitrary finite number of users.

articleTitle: An Efficient H.264 Transcoder with Spatial Downscaling for Wireless Communications
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Wireless video communication is an important application supported by 3G mobile communication systems. Motivated by the wide adoption of H.264 and the demand of universal multimedia data access over wireless network, this paper presents a fast video transcoder, working entirely in the DCT-domain, to convert high quality H.264 bitstream into low bit rate stream with low spatial resolution for wireless video access, furthermore, a motion vector estimation algorithm based on mapping and merging process is proposed to utilize the original motion information to predict motion vectors for the downscaled video. Simulation results show that, compared with the conventional transcoder, the proposed method significantly reduces the transcoding complexity while maintaining comparable rate distortion performance.

articleTitle: A Model for Parallel Data Mining Based on Multi-Agent
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the increasing number of data mining process, frequency of affairs distribution and results collection will increase in exponent, thus resulting in system overload. In order to improve the efficiency of data mining, this paper designed a parallel data mining model for centralized dataset only. The intelligent algorithm of the model reduces the system operation cost significantly and balances system load reasonably as well. The model system structure and the basic services each module provided are listed. The experiment proves that the model is suitable for the large scale, high precision and multi-dimensional data mining, it can also notably reduce the running time of mining process.

articleTitle: Group-Based Management of Multi-Channel Allocation Algorithm for Double Interfaces Wireless Mesh Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: As we know, the 802.11a/b/g wireless technology standards can provide a number of non-overlapping channels, and wireless mesh networks can take full advantage of available channels to improve network throughput. In this paper, according to the traffic characteristics of the wireless mesh networks, we use group-based management of multi-channel allocation method, and do some simulation experiments on OPNET modeler14.0. The final result shows that it can get better network throughput, compared with using single channel only.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of DTN Network Testbed Based on Linux
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Delay tolerant networks (DTNs) use a store-carry-forward communication model relying on the mobility of nodes because a persistent end-to-end path from source to destination generally does not exist. Being different from ad hoc, recent research in DTN is still in its infancy which mainly uses analytical model and simulation to analyze network protocols. As we all know, testbed is an important research method in the wireless study, so employing this method in DTN must have great significance. In this paper, we present the linux node which implements the DTN routing. Based on this idea, we implement the related protocol and construct our testbed, which contains 4 nodes including 2 fixed nodes and 2 mobile nodes. Our experiments show that the transmission of documents, audio and video can be supported and the process is stable and reliable. What's more, the primary focus of the mechanism is to raise the packet delivery rate in the DTN environment. And according to our experimental data, we do have a high packet delivery rate.

articleTitle: Effect of Space-Time Correlation on the Capacity in MIMO-OFDM Channel
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: MIMO-OFDM system is the main technology to the future wireless system. In this paper, to model multipath propagation and spatial-temporal fading correlation in frequency-selective channel, we propose a fading-correlated MIMO channel model. The channel is abstracted as a cluster-based double bounce model with multiple taps. Both transmitter and receiver are considered. The expressions of correlation coefficient and MIMO-OFDM channel capacity are derived, respectively. The effect of spatial temporal correlation on the capacity is investigated for different physical parameters. Increasing delay spread taps and cluster angular spread can increase the capacity. Two typical scenarios are simulated for indoor and outdoor environments.

articleTitle: Joint Method of Ultra Wideband Packet Acquisition Based on Energy Detection
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Focusing on the packet acquisition of UWB non-coherent system, a novel scheme is proposed in this article, which combines frame synchronization with signal acquisition and bit error probability (BEP) optimization together. Online signal to noise ratio (SNR) estimation is made for minimize BEP function after signal acquisition, combined with the search of optimal length of integral window. Experiments with Marker of 7 bits and 13 bits barker code respectively, demonstrate the constructed model, by Jump by K steps and Serial search algorithm individually. The results show that the proposed scheme improved significantly the BEP performance as well as packet acquisition performance.

articleTitle: A Detection Method of WCDMA Signal Based on the Quadratic Fourth-Order Moment Chip at Lower SNR
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Wideband code division multiple access signal is non-periodic signal, which always floods in the background noise, bringing difficulties to the signal's reconnaissance. In order to detecting this signal, the detection method based on the quadratic fourth-order moment chip of WCDMA is proposed, and the amount of calculation is reduced by using fast calculation method about fourth-order moment chip. Experimental results show that the detection performance of the method is better than that of the double frequency method, spectrum-reprocessing method. When the false alarm probability is 1%, the detection probability of presented methods reaches above 90% at SNR-21 dB.

articleTitle: An Improved MIEhD Backoff Algorithm in IEEE 802.11 MAC Layer
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper first described the IEEE 802.11 MAC layer access control mechanism DCF. Next, we analysis the basic and improved DCF back-off algorithm, and then we proposed exponential-half DCF back-off algorithm MIEhD. This algorithm is easy to implement and has excellent performance when there is small scale of nodes and avoiding the shortcomings of basic algorithm when there is large scale of nodes.

articleTitle: A Robust Detection Algorithm for the Multi-Path Channel
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In contrast to the conventional Viterbi algorithm (VA) which generates hard-outputs, an optimum soft-output Viterbi algorithm (SOVA) is derived under the constraint of fixed decision delay for detection of digital signals in the presence of intersymbol interference and additive white Gaussian noise. The SOVA, a new type of the conventional symbol-by-symbol maximum a posteriori probability algorithm, requires only a backward recursion and the number of variables to be stored. From computer simulations for an application example, a significant soft-decision gain can be obtained. Simplified variants with a complexity comparable to a conventional ML decoder are presented which perform almost as good as the optimum.

articleTitle: Scheduling Algorithm of Great Tolerance Wireless Communication Delay for Wireless Network Control System
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A majority of existing scheduling models of network control system are designed without considering the characteristic of wireless technology. They face serious degradations in wireless industrial applications. This paper proposed scheduling algorithm of great tolerance wireless communication delay (GTD). This algorithm resolves real-time problem of cycle communication task in wireless network control system (WNCS), and eases overtime phenomenon of cycle communication task caused by wireless network delay partly. Finally, we evaluate the performance of the proposed GTD for the WNCS. Simulation results show that it is more effective than traditional scheduling algorithms in the WNCS applications.

articleTitle: Implement Push to Talk Function in WinCE Based Terminals
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Fourth Generation (4G) mobile communications should not only focus on data rate increase and novel air interface, 4G mobile should converge the advanced wireless communications and high-speed wireless access. Considering the performance and cost, our research is now focusing on WLAN access. In order to study the 4G mobile handsets and other parts, we need a platform. Because no device provider could provide a commercial 4G phone, we implement our new features on some PDAs. This paper focuses on providing PTT group communication based on WinCE PDA using 802.11b wireless network interface cards in ad hoc mode. Considering the popularity of Windows products, we choose WinCE as the platform for our PDAs. We propose a framework to provide push-to-talk function on 4G phones. In order to implement that function, DSR/MSR routing protocols are ported to WinCE platform, and SIP signaling are modified and implemented on PDAs. Then the text messenger and media exchanging ability are added to the platform. Experiments show that our testbed could demonstrate the simplified PTT function and forward packet to correct mobile users.

articleTitle: Design Methodology of Concatenate Code for Extended RS Combined with Rotational Invariant TCM code
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Implementation of concatenate code has various problems such as frame synchronization and clock utilization for design on the FPGA chip. This paper proposed an efficient design methodology for serial concatenation coding of cable systems and fabrication on the FPGA chip Vertex II pro xc2vp30-5, Xilinx.

articleTitle: Study of Security Base on Wireless Sensor Network Routing Protocol
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the course of data transfer extremely vulnerable to be eavesdropped, defrauds, tampered or replayed (relay) routing by information security. Thus, the SLDMRP (security lightweight distribution multicast routing protocol) based on security was put forward in this paper. This protocol is designed on the basis of the multicast routing LDMRP, while this protocol creating and maintaining multicast group, sending control message, carrying out security policy which underwrite and verify the data packets, in order to prevent the control message from eavesdropping and tampering. Finally, using NS2, to prove the effectiveness of signature and verify. The simulation results: SLDMRP, which is using of SHA-1 and RSA encryption algorithm to verify the signature and security policy is effective.

articleTitle: APTLB: A Practical Approach for Providing Traffic Load-Balancing in Wireless Mesh Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: As a result of the nature of routing algorithm in a wireless mesh networks (WMNs), and although there is more than one hotspot access point (HSAP) in a WMN, the traffic load of each HSAP is quite different. A HSAP may be very busy during a particular period while the others are in very light loads, in consequence, of the inherent characteristic of routing algorithm of WMN. A traffic load concentrates on a HSAP may lead to network congestion, increase the packet loss rate and degrade the performance of network. Therefore, it is very necessary to provide a mechanism to guide part of a traffic load from busy HSAPs to light load HSAPs to balance the traffic load between all HSAPs. In this paper, a practical approach for providing traffic load-balancing (APTLB) mechanism is proposed to solve this problem. APTLB composed of two mechanisms schemes: the traffic load detection scheme (TLD) to discover the heavy load nodes through traffic load detection Scheme, and traffic load balancing scheme (TLB) to guide part of traffic from heavy loaded to light traffic loaded node. The simulation results indicate that the traffic balancing mechanism can enhance the performance of WMN.

articleTitle: A Blind CFO Estimation Algorithm for OFDMA Based on ESPRIT Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposes a blind carrier frequency offset (CFO) estimation algorithm based on estimating signal parameters via rotational invariance techniques (ESPRIT) algorithm for the interleaved orthogonal frequency division multiple access (OFDMA) uplinks. This method utilizes the special periodic structure of the received signal and the subspace rotational invariance techniques to estimate the CFO of all users. The main advantages of this method are that it obtains the CFOs of all users simultaneously within only one OFDMA block and has high accuracy due to the application of data reconstruction. Moreover, it saves frequency band effectively and degrades the computational complexity greatly. Because of estimation quickly it is suitable for the rapid change channel especially. Simulation results show that this algorithm has good performance even under low SNR condition and improves the variance performance a lot.

articleTitle: Analysis of Track Long-Wave Irregularity with Fractional Fourier Transform
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: As a generalization of classical Fourier Transformation (FT), the fractional Fourier transform (FrFT) outperforms many analysis techniques with its higher time-frequency resolution, but it is quite new to be employed into the track irregularity signal processing. In this paper, we simulate the data of the high-speed train's track, according to the data from the real test of the high-speed train on the railway. The FrFT has been investigated for the analysis of track long-wave irregularity, and some other typical methods are also used to analyze the data to estimate the track irregularity signal, including Fourier transform (FT) and short time Fourier transform (STFT). The results show that FrFT is more effective to detect track long-wave irregularity signal than traditional methods.

articleTitle: Integrated Priority Computing Scheme for Future Mobile Communication
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the development of IP and mobile communications, existing priority computing schemes can't satisfy the dynamic requirements of multi-service in future mobile communications system, for the influencing factors of user priority are relatively simple and lack of relevancy. To solve this problem, this paper proposes integrated priority computing (IPC) scheme, which establishes novel priority system structure. The structure includes static integrated priority (SIP) and dynamic integrated priority (DIP) by comprehensively taking into account multiple factors, and respectively describes their own computing schemes. This paper focuses on the dynamic integrated priority computing (DIPC) scheme, in which fuzzy analytic hierarchy process (FAHP) is applied to identify the relationship between users of different service and call type. Radar chart is used to analyze the rationality of the scheme, and the simulation results prove the validity of the scheme.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Industrial Determinants of Business Group: Evidence from China
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Improving Performance of VoIP Services in IEEE 802.16 OFDMA System
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: IEEE 802.16 is a promising technology in broadband wireless access area. In this paper, a novel performance analysis model is provided focusing on the VoIP services in TDD OFDMA-based IEEE 802.16 system. Based on the analysis results, a united packet aggregation scheme for both uplink and downlink is provided. The simulation results show that the packet aggregation in MAC layer not only improves the VoIP capacity but also guarantees the quality of VoIP through decreasing the VoIP packet delay.

articleTitle: A Scheduling Algorithm for Improving Fairness between Uplink TCP Flows
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Significant TCP unfairness in wireless local networks has been reported during the past several years. This unfairness results from the greedy TCP protocol and shared wireless medium. To solve the unfairness problem between uplink TCP flows, we proposed a scheduling algorithm called uplink weighted fair queueing (UWFQ). By adjusting the service weight of ACK packets, UWFQ achieves the channel adaptive fairness between uplink TCP flows. Analysis and simulation results show that UWFQ not only improves the fairness greatly, but also achieves higher total network throughput.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Channelized Receiving Problems in Passive Guiding System
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A method of combining phase-interferometer direction-finding and digital channelized receiving is adopted to provide angle of arrival information for signal sorting in passive guiding system. The method can realize multiple signals receiving simultaneously and digital phase discrimination. A method of high efficient channelized receiving based on polyphase filter structure and digital phase demodulation is raised according to signal real-time processing requirement in passive guiding system. The existing problems in the method which applied to passive guiding system is studied. The result indicates that structure and method are valid via construction of digital channelized receiving system and testing.

articleTitle: A Novel Adaptive Beamforming Algorithm for Aeronautical Communications
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the performance of different blind adaptive array algorithms in aeronautical communication systems. A novel algorithm named least-squares spread despread constant modulus algorithm (LS-SDCMA) is developed. The performance of the novel algorithm is compared with that of the existing multitarget least-squares constant modulus algorithm (MT-LSCMA) in the practical case and in the ideal case. It is shown from simulations that this novel algorithm can outperform the other algorithms in all test situations, and the bit-error-rate (BER) performance in the two extreme cases, the En-Route scenario and the Parking scenario.

articleTitle: A Cross-Layer Method to Improve Mobile Database Synchronization Performance
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In mobile database systems, the communication between clients and servers is weak connectivity, which is disadvantageous to synchronization and prone to bring about synchronization rollback. In order to solve the weak connectivity problem, researchers have put forward many solutions and their focuses are on application layer of network, however, the application layer does not know the real network conditions and can not adjust itself accordingly. This paper resolves this problem at transport layer. The paper adopts the TCP Westwood protocol as transport protocol, which adapts to wireless network better. Further, we use cross-layer method, allowing synchronization program to make use of the bandwidth estimated by TCP Westwood, to reduce the waste of communication resources induced by rollback of synchronization transactions in wireless network. Then we use Sybase SQL Anywhere to do experiments. The experimental results show that the cross-layer method can improve the synchronization performance of mobile database remarkably.

articleTitle: Decision Feedback Blind Equalization Algorithm Based on Momentum and Orthogonal Wavelet Packet Transform
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Towards the nonlinear underwater acoustic channels with the severe linear distortion, based on the fast de-correlation characteristic of wavelet packet transform, a decision feedback blind equalization algorithm based on momentum and orthogonal wavelet packet transform (MWPT-DFE) is proposed, which is derived by revising the iteration equation of forward weight vector for decision feedback structure blind equalizer. Comparing with normal decision feedback blind equalization algorithm (DFE) and the decision feedback blind equalization algorithm based on orthogonal wavelet Packet transform (WPT-DFE), the new algorithm has fast convergence, good performance for tracking and smaller MSE. The efficiency of the proposed algorithm is proved by computer simulation in underwater acoustic channels.

articleTitle: Effective Data Replication in Heterogeneous Structured P2P Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The traditional way to achieve high data availability in structured P2P network is to replicate the data items preserved on the node to its neighbor nodes. However, in some heterogeneous structured P2P networks, the neighbor nodes are always close to each other in locality. Therefore, if some local disaster happened, it is very likely that some data items would be permanent lost. Moreover, this traditional data replication strategy will bring complex data migration when there are nodes join or leave the DHT network. In this paper, we propose a novel data replication strategy in heterogeneous structured P2P networks. It not only guarantee the availability of data items in the situation of large-scale local disaster, but also greatly reduce the complexity of data migration when nodes join or leave the network.

articleTitle: A Scheme on the Implement of Software Radio Based on the Frequency Converting Technique
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on the superheterodyne receiving technology and software radio theory, the converter process and the frequency pushing process in the wide-scope intermediate frequency sampling and receiving structure are analysed in the view of converter technology, at the same time, a hardware realization scheme of software radio wide-scope intermediate frequency sampling receiver is put forward on the basis of frequency conversion technology.

articleTitle: Research on Service Level of City Railway Transport Hub
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to reach highest level of service of existing transport hub, and to distribute several kinds of passenger flows, here based on investigation of passengers' rational choice of travel mode when leaving station, the most influencing factors of the demand function model on traffic capacity outside the hub are extracted. In order to assess the synchrony of traffic flow between hub and road nearby, this paper analyzes the match between capacity and actual traffic volume. Finally, an evaluation about the hub service can be made. Take Hankou Train Station for a case study, we testify the feasibility of this method. The result can also provide the theory foundation for transport transformation and evaluation.

articleTitle: Widely Linear Momentum Linearly Constrained CMA for CDMA Blind Multiuser Detection
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A widely linear momentum linearly constrained constant modulus algorithm for the multi-access interferences (MAI) suppression in direct sequence code division multiple access (DS-CDMA) systems is proposed and analyzed in this paper. The widely linear estimation enables constant modulus algorithm (CMA) to produce better output signal to interference plus noise ratio (SINR) and the momentum fastens the convergence. Simulations have confirmed that the proposed algorithm performs better in a DS-CDMA system by employing a BPSK modulation than other algorithms that do not use widely linear processing and momentum.

articleTitle: Research of Minimum Energy Consumption Topology Construction in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Commenced with the local topology structure of wireless sensor networks, the energy consumption efficiency of single-hop and multi-hop communication is studied. With extremum method, the relation of energy consumption in single-hop and multi-hop communication was compared and then the alternative was given. Moreover, we obtain a theorem that the energy-saving relay region exists in the multi-hop communication node. Based on the theorem, the construction of whole minimum energy consumption topology in wireless sensor network is proposed. In the end, the varying regulation of the energy-saving relay region with the position between nodes is analyzed in the experiments. The experiments analyzed the varying regulation of the energy-saving relay region with the positions of nodes, and finally the correctness and rationality of the minimum energy consumption topology construction was validated.

articleTitle: The Implementation and Optimization of TD-SCDMA Joint Detection and Decoding
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper describes the implementation and optimization of TD-SCDMA joint detection and decoding, including channel re-estimation algorithm, soft de-rate-matching algorithm. The proposed algorithms can improve the performance, especially when the interference is great. The proposed algorithms can be applied in not only TD-SCDMA system, but also the evolution of TD-SCDMA, wireless local area network etc.

IEEE Keywords: Time division synchronous code division multiple access

articleTitle: The Impact of Simulation Area Shape on the Performance of Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The shape of the simulation area is critical in simulations because average hops of source to destination will change in different shapes. We measure one reliability metric (connectivity) and five efficiency metrics (round trip time, drop rate, energy cost, routing overhead and throughput goodput) in various shapes of simulation areas. Three routing protocols (DSDV, AODV and DSR) are carefully studied in different mobility patterns as well as speeds. Results show that DSDV performs the worst in most cases except in the case of round trip time. We prove that network efficiency metrics enhance when the reliability metric decreases. One exception is that the throughput descends when the horizon length increases. The key reason, we believe, is that the influence of network partitioning out-ranks the impact of network transmission condition improvement.

articleTitle: Optimum Power Loading with Arbitrary Square MQAM for OFDM Systems
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: An adaptive power loading algorithm for orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) systems with given arbitrary square M-ary quadrature amplitude modulation(MQAM) modes on subcarriers is proposed in this paper. This algorithm aims to minimize the total transmit power while guaranteeing the target overall bit error rate (BER), and can achieve the optimum power loading results through optimizing the BER distribution. The closed-form expressions for optimal BER and power distributions are presented. Simulation results indicate the superiority of the proposed algorithm in terms of algorithmic performance and complexity.

articleTitle: A Face Detector Based on Hausdorff Distance
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Face detector is used very often as a previous step in some biometric applications, like face recognition or advanced human computer interaction,, which usually needs the face detection step to be efficient and robust enough to achieve better results. In this paper Hausdorff distance is used to search interested region, which is more similar to a face. A further verification step is taken to detect some false positives. Experiments show that the proposed face detector can perform accurate face detection even with complex background.

articleTitle: A Novel Fault Signal Detection Method
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Aiming at the fault signal detection in mechanism system, all phase fast Fourier transform (APFFT) method is proposed for fault detection. The method of APFFT has the outstanding characteristics: the very few power leaks, the zero phase error and the fewer side lobes. So it can resist noise and increase the validity of diagnosis results. Finally, the case of bearing diagnosis is given by using the method of APFFT. The simulation results indicate that APFFT method has better character of fault detection. And it is more robust compared to FFT method. Especially, the power leak based on APFFT is fewer and equal to the square of the power leak based on the conventional FFT. So the APFFT method has the better diagnosis ability.

articleTitle: Limited Feedback Open Loop Precoding in the Downlink Relay Multiuser MIMO System
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the wireless communication system, multi-input multi-output technique can be used to increase capacity. In the MIMO system, the non-linear precoding can archive the MIMO channel capacity through perfect feedback with a high complexity. To reduce the complexity, linear precoding with limited feedback information rate is used in most of simultaneous communication system. Further more, open loop precoding is also able to reduce the complexity. Since the codebook has been chosen in the transmitter side, the size of codebook could be enlarged to reduce the loss from deviation of the quantification of codebook. Compare between the full feedback of open loop linear precoding in Relay Multi User MIMO system and the limited feedback of open loop precoding, we can conclude that this open loop precoding in relay MU-MIMO has a low feedback information rate with small capacity loss.

articleTitle: Parameter gamma Conditions for Stability of FAST TCP
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The stability of FAST TCP in a single-link single-source is studied in this paper. A continuous time fluid flow model of the link buffer is considered to build a linear control system model related to fast TCP. Linearing the fluid flow model and window control model, Laplace transform version of the equations are presented. It results in a negative feedback system with open loop transfer function. With the analysis of Nyquist curve of the system, a sufficient condition on asymptotical stability of fast TCP congestion window related to the parameter gamma is obtained. Packet level NS2 simulations are used to verify the theoretical claims.

articleTitle: Study on System of Fiber Optic Strain Signal Sampling and Processing Based on LabVIEW
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, the signal sampling and processing system of fiber optic strain based on Lab VIEW is designed and implemented. In order to achieve health monitoring for bridges and intelligent buildings, the collected strain data are managed by means of storing the data into the founded table of database in LabSQL, which can achieve long-time running, large-capacity data acquiring and historical data inquiring and analyzing etc. The system mentioned in this paper can implement synchronous multi-channel real-time data acquisition and analysis for fiber-optic strain signal, which also can analyze signals by used of histogram threshold value analysis in time domain and energy spectral density analysis in frequency domain. This system has such advantages as high precision, flexible to operation, large storage and easy to extend and so on. It has the broad application prospect in the field of structural health monitoring.

articleTitle: A Rapid & Precise Algorithm Finding Zeros of Polynomials
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A rapid & precise algorithm was proposed to find zeros of polynomials which were not solved by some traditional methods. Its convergence theorem was presented and proved. The computation was carried out by simple steepest descent rule with the variable learning rate. The specific examples illustrated that the proposed method can find the roots of polynomials with less computation, rapid convergence and high accuracy. Furthermore, it had also the added advantage of being able to compute exactly complex roots.

articleTitle: An Enhanced Method for the Quiet Period Synchronization of IEEE 802.22-Based Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: To avoid interferences, network-wide quiet periods (QPs) are usually scheduled for the purpose of channel sensing in cognitive radio (CR) networks. The recent IEEE 802.22 draft standard requires that adjacent base stations (BSs) should synchronize their QP in scheduling. However, we find that the current design is incomplete in handling the dynamic of synchronized QP. The problem is that BSs cannot handle the decreasing of synchronized QP duration. This can cause the wastage of network resources. To solve the problem, we propose a synchronization counter (SC)-based method in this paper. With the method, the BSs can accurately synchronize the QP when the duration varies. It makes the synchronization more accurate and thus saves the network resources. We have verified the proposed scheme with simulation and provide the performance results that reveal the basic features of network-wide QP synchronization.

articleTitle: An Novel Energy-Efficient Redundant Routing Tree Algorithm for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Nodes in wireless sensor networks(WSNs) are tiny and energy-limited,so in order to enhance the entire network lifetime, this paper puts forward a novel energy efficient redundant routing tree(EE-RRT) algorithm for wireless sensir networks. EE-RRT has three obvious features: Firstly, it improves virtual grid ideas to divide each cluster into MtimesN square area and select a working node in each grid to reduce redundant information and economize energy. Secondly, EE-RRT improves energy utility by changing the activity of wireless communication module of sensor nodes, energy model and state transition of sensor nodcs.hist.it builds a redundant routing tree as the transmission agents to realize the information exchange between the clusters and base-station so that the energy consumption of normal nodes and clusters' heads can be decreased and reduces the dynamic clustering time to save energy. Simulation results show that, compared with LEACH and RNTA,EE-RRT significantly reduce in energy consumption and prolong the network lifetime.

articleTitle: Estimation and Compensation of Frequency-Dependent I/Q Imbalances in OFDM Systems over Fading Channels
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, the estimation and compensation of frequency-dependent in-phase/quadrature-phase (I/Q) imbalances in an OFDM-based communication system is studied over fading channels. The input-output relation of this system is derived in closed-form in the frequency domain. Based on the result, two novel approaches are proposed to jointly estimate and compensate the distortion coefficients. The first method utilizes least square algorithm, while the second employs an adaptive normalized least mean square algorithm. The simulation results show that both approaches can almost reach the performance of the system without I/Q imbalances in the time-invariant multipath channels. By utilizing decision feedback scheme, the adaptive method outperforms the least square method in the time-varying fading channels at high signal-to-noise ratios.

articleTitle: EBAS: An Energy-Efficient Event Boundary Approximated Suppression Algorithm in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Monitoring events and detecting event boundaries are fundamental problems in wireless sensor networks. Moreover, users may want to know the event fields. All these problems present great challenges: in order to get event fields, we have to collect information from all the nodes that lie in field boundaries. Obviously, it means much communication and therefore, much more energy consuming. Meanwhile, the more data needs to be sent, the higher the message packet missing rate is. It incurs inaccurate event fields. Based on the above situation, we propose a novel energy-efficient algorithm named EBAS. With the help of EBAS, we could save a great amount of energy without much loss of accuracy of event fields. Finally, simulated experiment results proved the correctness and effectiveness of EBAS.

articleTitle: The Lightweight Currency and File Share in Geography-Aware Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Virtual currency is used widely in e-community and is usually managed in centralized form which is not suited for ad hoc networks. With the debt exchange protocol a lightweight currency is constructed in distributed form in ad hoc service network. Debt relationship need only be maintained between neighbors, so the currency mechanism can scale in large networks. But the debt network topology is so variable that only greedy routing or flooding can be used in such a setting. The geographic routing arithmetic is borrowed for effective routing. An analysis about file share application show that because neighbors interact repeatedly, a cooperative equilibrium can be attained, in which the debt relationship can be maintained spontaneous by neighbors according to their own interests.

articleTitle: Applied Research on Quantum Key Distribution Technology in Distributed Space TT&C Network
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The quantum key distribution technology is an emerging technology, which uses quantum mechanics properties of micro-particles. The progress of quantum key distribution can generate the quantum key which can be kept strictly confidential. The application of quantum key distribution technology in distributed space TT & C network can improve the existing communication environment and enhance communications security. This article will detail the model of quantum key distribution technology in distributed space TT & C network and simulate the situation with self-designed simulation platform.

articleTitle: Channel Capacity of MIMO Multi-Carrier Modulation in Additive Noise
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the capacity of multi-carrier modulation (MCM) system based on multiple input multiple output (MIMO) antennae for single user communications over the additive noise channel. We define a two variable energy spectrum function for each antenna which describes energy distribution in time-frequency-space (T-F-S) subchannels. The general wavelet packet basis functions are employed as sub-carrier to give more flexibility to partition of T-F plane compared with Inverse Fast Fourier Transform and Fast Fourier Transform (IFFT/FFT). The total energy and T-F space constraints are given. Under the prior information of additive noise energy distribution, the water-filling resolution is derived to obtain maximum objective capacity function. Furthermore, the optimal resource distribution in three dimensions space is obtained finally.

articleTitle: The Important Impact of Energy in 802.11e EDCA Network
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we present that the energy is one of the most important performance parameters in IEEE 802.11e enhanced distributed channel access (EDCA) mechanism, there are few papers has referred. We think about two cases: saturation and non-saturation. The energy isn't linear with the impact, but in a certain energy value, the high priority traffic with lower energy can't compete with the low priority traffic with higher energy, that is if the energy of high priority traffic decrease, its performance will decline; on the contrary, the traffic with low priority will increase the access opportunity and improve its performance in the condition of its energy higher than above traffic. The simulation result demonstrates our conclusion validly.

articleTitle: Signal Processing Algorithm of Spaceborne SIMO HF-SAR for Three-Dimensional Topside Ionosphere Exploration
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Ionosphere exploration is very important to improve the performance of space information systems, e.g. satellite navigation. A novel of spaceborne nadir-looking single input and multiple output (SIMO) HF-SAR is investigated, which has the capability to generate three-dimensional radar image for the topside ionospheric irregularities. The three-dimensional radar echo signal modeling is developed. The image formation algorithm for the antenna array typed SIMO HF-SAR system is proposed, based on modification of extend chirp scaling (ECS) algorithm. Computer simulation results illustrate the feasibility of new radar system and the validation of the signal processing algorithm. It has very good potential to be applied to the new generation ionospheric explorer developed in the future.

articleTitle: Research on Channel Estimating Algorithm in CMMB System under Complex Environment
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we researched the channel estimation algorithms detailedly in China mobile multimedia broadcasting (CMMB) system and proposed an improved algorithm which is derived from channel estimation algorithm based on transform domain according to the structure of discrete pilot in CMMB system. In pilot estimation, the performance of least-square (LS) algorithm and modified minimum mean-squared error (MMSE) was compared through system simulation. To evaluate the interpolation algorithms, we analyzed the theories of linear interpolation algorithm and which based on transform domain. Simulation results show that the modified MMSE pilot estimation algorithm can reduce the influence of AWGN on the accuracy of channel estimation and the interpolation algorithm based on DFT can effectively reject inter symbol interference (ISI) under the environment with Doppler shift.

articleTitle: A QoS Routing Algorithm Based on Game Theory for Ad Hoc Networks Having Small-World Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the development of network theory, the new science of complex networks has brought new ideas for the ad hoc network research. The small-world network has a high clustering coefficient and small average path length characteristics. This paper designs a multi-constraint QoS routing algorithm of ad hoc network having small-world characteristics. It is aimed at the dynamic environment of ad hoc network and link state information is uncertain, even ambiguous. Through Game analysis, this paper looks for the NP-complete problem of optimal or sub-optimal solution and enables users and network providers to meet the utility of Nash Equilibrium Pareto optimal. The simulation shows that the algorithm is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: A CMOS Transmitter Front-End for Mobile UHF RFID Reader
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper describes a 900 MHz CMOS transmitter front-end for mobile UHF RFID reader including an I/Q up-mixer for frequency translation from IF to RF and a driver amplifier for signal pre-amplification. The proposed up-mixer can realize all the three modulation schemes specified in EPC Global C1G2 protocol. The driver amplifier can offer a seven-class adjustable conversion gain through a 3-bit gate bias control. Fabricated in IBM 0.18 mum CMOS process, the transmitter frontend consumes a minimum current of 14 mA from a 1.8 V power supply. The experimental results show that the up-mixer achieves -4.9 dBV<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rms</sub> IIP3, 3.18 dB conversion gain and 13.20 dB NF, and the DA features 13.5 dBm OIP3 at 50 Omega, 7.90-16.30 dB conversion gain variation and 3.10-5.00 dB NF range.

articleTitle: An Iterative Decoding Method Based on Gaussian Approximation for LDPC Coded Modulations
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we propose an improved iterative demapping/decoding method for short length low-density paritycheck (LDPC) coded bit-interleaved coded modulations (BICM). For short length LDPC, there exist cycles in the bipartite graph, thereby leading to the high correlation among the extrinsic information of bits out from BP decoder. Based on the Gaussian assumption of the extrinsic log-likelihood ratios (LLRs)delivered by BP decoder, we multiply the extrinsic output of the decoder by a scaling factor and then pass it as a priori information to the demodulator for the next iteration. In this way, we can decrease the correlation of coded bits within the symbol and thus reduce the error propagation. Simulation results show that the proposed method can achieve noticeable performance gains for short length LDPC coded BICM-ID with a minor computation complexity increase.

articleTitle: Role-Based Collaboration Model of Security Devices
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper describes several typical current mechanisms of security device collaboration and summarizes the collaboration models. And then a role-based security collaboration framework is introduced to classify the security devices into sensors, analyzers and executors. Based on the framework, a two-tiered policy mechanism is proposed to improve collaboration effect between sensors and executors.

articleTitle: PN Code Sequence Estimation Based on SOM Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: To detect and estimate direct sequence spread spectrum (DSSS) signals in a non-cooperative scene, an novel algorithm based on the self organizing map (SOM) neural network is proposed in this paper. We demonstrate by simulation that this method can indeed well perform the PN sequence detection and estimation under a low signal to noise ratio (SNR), and it is much superior to any other traditional methods.

articleTitle: Unequal Error Protection Based on Symmetric Slepian-Wolf Coding in Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we consider the problem of unequal error protection based on symmetric Slepian-Wolf coding in wireless sensor networks. Compared to the asymmetric scheme that appears in our previous work, the new scheme owns almost the same decoding performance and unequal error protection capability. Due to its flexible rate allocation, symmetric Slepian-Wolf coding based scheme would be more practical for the design of wireless sensor network.

articleTitle: A Limited Broadcast Algorithm (LBA)
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In wireless Ad hoc networks, broadcast plays an important role in the process of route finding and maintenance. The efficiency of broadcast affects the performance of the whole network largely. The paper proposes a limited broadcast algorithm (LBA), which defines a neighbor information table and chooses some neighbor nodes as transmission nodes in order to reduce the redundant radio broadcasts and improve the broadcast efficiency. We can also modify the broken route through neighbor information table. The simulation result shows that LBA controls the broadcast storm problem and improves the network performance.

articleTitle: Distributed Architecture for Intrusion Detection System Based on Multi-SoftMan
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: "SoftMan" (SM) is a new concept based on the production of distributed technique, agent, intelligent robot and artificial life, its corresponding theory and technology fruits provide a good foundation and reference for studying the present intrusion detection systems (IDSs). Inspired by the intelligence recognition capability of SM, a novel cooperation control model for intrusion detection system based on multi-SoftMan (MSMIDS) is proposed. This model is adopted distributed architecture. In order to reduce the relativity of each detection components as far as possible and avoid the simple failure point caused by the single central analyzer, the model is adopted the non-control center multi-SoftMan architecture, which is making enough use of SM attributes, such as independence, activity, self-learning, self-adaptation, self-evolution and society. The experimental results show that MSMIDS enables member sites in the same trust community or different ones to forewarn attacks cooperatively, and possesses the higher detection rate, load balance and better self-adaptability. MSMIDS also provides a new idea for implementation of network security system.

articleTitle: A Threshold Proxy Signature Scheme from Bilinear Pairings
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Threshold proxy signature is a variant of the proxy signature scheme in which only some subgroup of proxy signers can sign messages on behalf of the original signer. Many existing threshold proxy signature schemes reveal that the receiver cannot find out who signed the proxy signatures. In this article, we provided a novel (t,n) threshold proxy signature scheme from bilinear pairings without a trusted dealer. In our scheme, the original signer can know who generated the proxy signature, and the receiver can certify the actuality of the group signers who made the proxy signature. Most of our constructions would be simpler but still with high security due to the properties of bilinear map built from Weil pairing or Tate pairing.

articleTitle: Multiuser WiMAX Resource Allocation Algorithm Based on Cognitive Radio
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on the OFDM technique and the character of cognitive radio (CR), a multiuser WiMAX resource allocation algorithm is proposed. In the algorithm, cognitive users use the vacant spectrum resources under the condition of not interfering the primary users based on the spectrum information detections. Make use of water-filling algorithm to one or more users requesting the use of same subcarrier to carry through the arbitration, moreover, achieve subcarrier, bit and power allocation satisfying the bit rate and QoS demand, and bring the total transmit power to the minimum. Simulation results indicate that our method has the lower transmit power and better performance compared with static algorithms.

articleTitle: Throughput-Optimal Scheduling for Downlink Zero-Forcing SDMA Systems
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The downlink zero-forcing beamforming strategy in the case of random packet arrivals is investigated. Under this setting, the relevant fairness criterion is the stabilization of all buffer queues which guarantees a bounded average delay for all users. It has been shown that maximizing a queue-length-weighted sum of the rates is an optimal in the sense that it can guarantee stability of the system. A good cross layer scheduling scheme should jointly consider the queue length and the channel variation of the channel from the physical layer. The average delay, average throughput, and average user queue length of the channel-aware-only scheduling, queue-aware-only scheduling and joint channel-aware and queue-aware scheduling are evaluated. Simulation results show that the joint channel-aware and queue-aware scheduling algorithm can take full advantage of the multiuser diversity gain and provide average delay (or throughput) and fairness improvement compared with channel-aware-only schemes and queue-aware-only schemes.

articleTitle: Transmission over Single Mode Fiber Link with Convolutional Encoding
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: An optical signal transmission over single mode optical fiber with convolutional coding is demonstrated by simulations. The simulation results state that the performance of single mode optical fiber communication is improved by applying convolutional encoding and decoding at high signal-to-noise ratio.

articleTitle: Sphere Decoding Assisted GA-Based Multiuser Detection for Synchronous LAS Multicode System
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Multicode system is designed to get more spreading sequences and get higher multiplexing capacity in large-area-synchronized code division multiple access (LAS-CDMA) system. The computational complexity is too high for the optimum detection algorithm using maximum-likelihood (ML) rule and the genetic algorithm (GA) method is often applied to get the suboptimum solution since it is able to greatly decrease the detection complexity. Another sphere decoding (SD) algorithm can also independently reach a near-optimum solution due to a constrained searching operation. A modified detection algorithm based on genetic algorithm method is proposed, where sphere decoding is an additional embedded operation for each GA iteration. The simulation results shows that a SD-assisted GA detector can obtain the same performance as that of the classic GA detector with fewer iterations.

articleTitle: A System for Fast Positioning SLA Violations
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to improve the customer's QoS satisfaction, a method and a system for fast positioning SLA violations are designed in this paper. First, a kind of database called SLA violation experience database and a system for fast positioning SLA violations are brought forward. Then, a tree called SLA violation experience tree is built based on the Huffman. Finally, the system is tested by some examples. The system is efficient and reasonable.

articleTitle: Performance of Training-Based Channel Estimation Methods in a MIMO System Employing Uniform Circular or Linear Array Antennas
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The paper reports on the performances of training-based channel estimation methods in a multiple input multiple output (MIMO) communication system with transmitter equipped with a uniform linear array (ULA) and receiver equipped with either uniform circular array (UCA) or uniform linear array (ULA). In the undertaken investigations, the receiver is assumed to be free from any obstacles while the transmitter is surrounded by scattering objects. Spatial correlation for the ULA and UCA receiving antenna cases is determined under the Laplacian distribution of angle of arrival (AOA).

articleTitle: Adaptive Codebook Selection for Limited Feedback MIMO Beamforming Systems
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A combined codebook for limited feedback multi-input multi-output (MIMO) beamforming system is proposed, where two grassmannian codebooks are combined together to make a set of new codebooks, and from which to choose the codebook for quantification. The codebook selection information is implied in the feedback codeword indexes, thus we can to switch the codebook adaptively. Simulation results show that this method can be used to any channel models, and at the same BER, this method can reduce the feedback rate compare to grassmannian codebooks in correlated channels.

articleTitle: A Novel Image Filtering Algorithm in Image Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we presented a novel image filtering algorithm (EdgeFilter) using image edge detection and preservation for image enhancement. The proposed algorithm firstly defines the region direction gradient to detect the image edge pixel with dynamic threshold control, and then it implements a modified hybrid filter method to each edge pixel and each smoothing pixel, which aims at preserving the image edges and suppressing the noises in the operation of image filtering. Experiment results illustrate that EdgeFilter can improve the edge preserving performance in terms of PSNR and Edge Similarity which indicates the performance of edge preserving.

articleTitle: Antenna Pattern Effects on the Capacity of Multielement Antenna System
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we propose a new method to analyze the effect of antenna pattern on multiple-input-multiple-output (MIMO) capacity. The method is based on spatial channel model (SCM) and couples antenna gain to the channel propagation matrix. To investigate the effect of antenna pattern on MIMO capacity, we employ omni antenna and directive antenna realized by dipole antenna. Simulation results show that capacity performance under the same environment varies with different antenna pattern.
