This kind of overlap may degrade the estimation performance or even cause some estimators' failure. How to mitigate the overlap distortion is critical in MIMO uplink synchronization. This paper first analyzed the inter-TS-interference in MIMO uplink synchronization. For an unbiased carrier frequency offset estimator, its Cramer-Rao Lower Bound (CRLB) is also derived. Two Lemmas without proof are also provided for MIMO uplink synchronization. With received Signal-to-Interference-plus-Noise Ratio (SINR) known at the receiver, a joint carrier frequency offset estimator, named as Joint Best Linear Estimator (JBLUE), is also proposed. Simulation results prove that a great performance improvement with regard to estimation accuracy can be expected by using JBLUE when performing MIMO uplink synchronization.

articleTitle: A Certificateless-Based Key Distribution Scheme with Multi-KGCs In P2P Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the application of P2P networks becoming more extensive, its security issues attract more and more attention. This paper proposes a certificateless-based key distribution scheme with multi-KGCs that fits the characteristics of P2P networks. The proposed scheme introduces threshold technology, and it needs a certain number of KGCs working together to generate the partial private key for the user. Therefore this scheme can prevent less than a certain number of malicious KGCs colluding to forge the user's private key, and can work properly even when no more than a certain number of KGCs fail. So it is secure and robust.

articleTitle: Consecutive Mean Excision Based Signal Existence Detection in AWGN
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper treats the problem of signal existence detection of universal signals in additive white Gaussian noise (AWGN) condition from the new angle. The signal is seen as 'interference' and the consecutive mean excision (CME) algorithm is used to finding out the 'interference'. Any a priori information about the signal and the noise is not required. The performance of the detector is analyzed and an equation is gained to explain the influence of signal power to noise power ratio (SNR) on the probability of detection. Monte Carlo computer simulations are carried out and detailed discussions are made for each test. The results verify that the proposed method could detect the signal with detection probability 1 when the SNR is above 0 dB.

articleTitle: A Context-Aware Multicast Approach for Multimedia Applications in Wireless Environment
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the constant development of multimedia technologies and mobile devices, the demand of transmitting multimedia streams to mobile devices will be one of the major applications in wireless networks. But the categories of devices and user preference vary widely. How to provide appropriate multimedia streams to mobile terminals and how to process the received multimedia content in the user side will be a potential application for content providers and service operators. In this paper, we propose a context-aware multimedia multicast approach which is composed of two sides - server side and client side to deal with the above problems. This approach can not only decrease the frequencies between server side and client side in wireless environment but also decrease the initiative manual user intervention.

articleTitle: Pulse Compression of LFM Signal Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Presently, a widely used method to compress signal with linear frequency modulation is based on DSP and realized by software. This way not only has no advantages on real-time operations but also has high requirement of hardware quantity in the case of processing large FFT points. To overcome these shortcomings, we have proposed a new method to achieve the pulse compression of LFM (Linear Frequency Modulated) signal through FPGA as well as the simulation results. In contrast with using DSP, our new method which uses FPGA has a much better performance on reliability, speed and a lower demand of hardware quantity.

articleTitle: Environmental Monitoring System Based on Sensor Networks Using Multi-Channel MAC Protocol
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we present a wireless sensor network based environmental monitoring system. The sensor network operates under mesh topology. Nodes are composed of RF transceiver CC1100, low power microprocessor C8051F920 and relevant components such as sensors. The MAC protocol accompanies TDMA/FDMA, frequency hopping and duty-cycled receiving, realizing a collision-free, energy efficient and low latency link. The data received by the sink node is finally uploaded to the Internet through Web service. Users around world can get access to the data by pointing on the map.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Mobile GeoSpatial Information System for Public Health Emergency
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: As mobile devices like personal digital assistant (PDA) or handheld PC (HPC) are rapidly developing and the wireless Internet is increasingly used, interests in the mobile geospatial information system are gradually expanded. Nowadays, the outbreak of emergent public health events can be heard more often than before and make lots of people ill in a short time. How to deal with the events much more rapidly and efficiently are the main factors needed to be considered. With the development of mobile devices and wireless network, according to the characteristics of emergent public health event, the authors have designed and implemented a mobile geospatial information system based on PDA for public health emergency. The platform integrates the technologies of geographic information system (GIS), Global Positioning System (GPS), global system for mobile communication (GSM) and general packer radio service (GPRS). Based on platform, the paper conducts an experimental case study of HFRS (hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome) fieldwork, and test the effectiveness and usefulness of field survey based on mobile collaboration.

articleTitle: A Performance Analysis of the AoE Protocol
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper introduced a new IP-storage protocol named Ata over Ethernet (AoE), then modeled and analyzed the performance of it. To prove the theoretical analysis, we tested AoE implementation under various system configurations, i.e., under different physical layer parameters. We found that both of them affect AoE performance at different levels. In addition, deficiency of AoE was also found, i.e., the acknowledge system is relatively poor.

articleTitle: Design of 5.8 GHz Dielectric Resonator Oscillator Applied in Electronic Toll Collection
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the electronic toll collection (ETC) application, the dielectric resonator oscillator (DRO) must exhibit low phase noise in order to meet bit error rate requirements. It also should provide enough output power to directly drive the mixer. This paper designs the DRO in the 5.8 GHz by negative resistance theory and harmonic balance theory with use of Agilent advance design system (ADS) tool. The dielectric resonator is modeled as a package of cResP in ADS. After the simulation and optimization of the nonlinear models of the DRO, the satisfying result was found. At @ 5.8 GHz, the output power was exhibited exceed 10 dBm, phase noise was less than -95 dBc.

articleTitle: High Speed, High Resolution and Low Power Approaches for SAR A/D Converter
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Through the review and analysis of traditional and some recently reported conversion methods in SAR A/D converters, high speed, high resolution and low power approaches for SAR A/D converter are discussed. Based on SMIC 65 nm CMOS technology, two typical low power methods reported in previous works are validated by circuit design and simulation. Design challenges and considerations of high speed SAR A/D converter are presented. Moreover, C-R combination based high resolution approach is discussed. Finally, a novel R-C combination based method is also addressed and a 10-bit SAR A/D converter with this approach is implemented in SMIC 90 nm CMOS process.

articleTitle: A Code-Aided Soft Frame Synchronization Algorithm for Quasi-Cyclic LDPC Coded System
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A LDPC code-aided frame synchronization algorithm based on maximum-likelihood rule is proposed. Firstly the probability presenting the satisfaction of all check restrictions in the quasi-cyclic LDPC parity-check matrix for soft information vectors with different frame offsets are computed respectively, and then the point corresponding to the maximum value is chosen as the final frame synchronization point. Because of the cyclic nature of quasi-cyclic LDPC codes, a PN sequence is used to overcome the inherent ramp of the probability computed in synchronization search process. Compared to other code-aided frame synchronization algorithms, simulation results show favorable synchronization performance of the new code-aided frame synchronization algorithm based on soft information.

articleTitle: Mode Scattering Analysis of Large Scale Antenna Array
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The electromagnetic mode scattering of large scale antenna array is approximated in this paper. The radiation pattern of the large array is simulated with HFSS software using array synthesizing function firstly, and then, the radar cross-section (RCS) is obtained by some simple formulations. It is efficient to analyze the mode scattering of large scale antenna array including some large scale phased array with this method.

articleTitle: Broadband Printed-Circuit Yagi Array
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Printed circuit board (PCB) antenna with useful bandwidth covering from 2.45 GHz to 3.80 GHz is suitable for WiMax, WLAN, and Bluetooth wireless communications applications. We present a low profile, seven elements Yagi array antenna etched on PCB of dielectric constant 4.2 achieving 43% bandwidth with return loss better than -10 dB, and directivity from 8.2 dBi to 11.1 dBi. Swept frequency return loss, impedance and radiation patterns of this antenna have been simulated and measured: The congruence between the simulated and measured results is satisfactory. In addition, current distribution on this broadband Yagi is also investigated.

articleTitle: Cognitive Ultra-Wideband Radio Based on Adaptive Spectrum Allocation and Rake Receiver
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Cognitive ultra-wideband(UWB) radio is supposed to economically solve the evermore serious problem of a spectrum scarcity at frequencies. In order to achieve this purpose, adaptive UWB pulse generation and spectrum allocation algorithm are investigated for utilizing the unique capability of UWB and cognitive radio technology. In this paper, an adaptive pulse generation algorithm based on a new pulse waveform design method of ultra wideband pulse is presented and employed into an UWB communication system with different Rake receiver, which can explore the adaptive pulse generation to realize a high date rate and high performance cognitive radio communication system. We evaluate this cognitive ultra-wideband radio system in a multi-path channel model proposed by the 802.15.3a Working Group and give the BER performance. With concern of acceptable complexity of system structure and low interference to primary (often licensed) users, this proposed scheme can be applied to different scenario.

articleTitle: An Energy-Balanced Data Transmission Scheme for Clustered Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The evenness of energy consumption is one of design challenges for data transmission in wireless sensor networks (WSNs) which are affected by the energy-hole problem. With the circular network model which typically represents for a cluster in the clustered WSNs, we sliced the circular field into concentric circular bands of fixed width. A energy-balanced consumption scheme is then presented by combining the direct transmission protocol and multi-hop transmission protocol. Different from other existed schemes, our scheme can give a closed-form solution for the probability of multi-hop transmission mode and that of direct transmission mode. Numerical results show our scheme balances the energy consumptions of the sensors in different bands, while keeping the total energy consumption in a rather low level.

articleTitle: One Extension of Authentication Test Based on Strand Space Model
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Authentication test is a formal method of verifying the security protocols based on strand space model. However, it hardly analyzes some complex security protocols on account of its poor cryptographic primitives. This paper proposes one way of extension of authentication test based on strand space model. First, message term, the in-term relation and penetrator model in strand space model are extended. Then; three concepts of transformed edge, transforming edge and test component in authentication test are extended. Eventually, TLS1.0 handshaking protocol is analyzed with the proposed approach, and property of authentication is verified.

articleTitle: Study of Neural Network Technologies in Intrusion Detection Systems
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In recent years, the network attack become more and more widespread and difficult in against. Intrusion Detection is a major focus of research in network security. This paper analyzes neural network (NN) methods being used in IDS, in which five different types of NNs are described: multilayer perceptrons (MLP), radial basis function (RBF), self-organizing feature map (SOFM), adaptive resonance theory (ART) and principal component analysis (PCA). An intrusion detection system combined with genetic algorithm (GA) and backpropagation (BP) network is presented. Finally, a discussion of the future NN technologies, which guarantee to enhance the detection efficiency of IDS is provided.

articleTitle: BREAC: Broadcast Routing Based on Edmonds Algorithm for Ad Hoc Networks with Asymmetric Cost Model
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Broadcast is a common communication paradigm in wireless ad hoc networks. This is fulfilled by constructing a spanning tree for the underlying graph model based on link costs. We have investigated various ways in defining link cost function. The study shows that asymmetric link costs provide better modeling of the network. Under such circumstances, simple minimum spanning tree algorithms which deal with undirected graphs yield only sub-optimal broadcast paths. This has motivated us to propose broadcast routing based on Edmonds algorithm in this paper. The resulting broadcast routing scheme is called BREAC. The major steps of the algorithm are described and the implementation is examined. Differences between BREAC and existing methods are highlighted by depicting the broadcast trees generated by the individual methods. Performance of the methods is further compared using several metrics. The results indicate that BREAC prevails over the others in terms of path energy and lifetime.

articleTitle: Two-Level Buffer State Report Scheme for 3GPP LTE System
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Taking the uplink scheduling technique in 3GPP LTE system into consideration, the two-level buffer state report (BSR) scheme is proposed as a better candidate solution for uplink resource allocation in LTE system and future beyond third-generation system. In the proposed two-level scheme, the second level BSR content is a complement information of the BSR in LTE system which is regarded as the first level BSR to indicate the relation state about buffer size and the relative token bucket number of radio bearer (RB), and it can improve the utilization of radio resources and meet the QoS requirements of traffics in scenario of multiple users with multiple radio bearers without extra signaling overhead.

articleTitle: Nonstationary Interference Suppression in DSSS System Using Time-Frequency Distribution and Polynomial Phase Signal Model
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A new approach for nonstationary interference suppression in Direct Sequence Spread Spectrum communication (DSSS) is introduced in the paper, which is based on Time-Frequency Distribution (TFD) and Polynomial Phase Signal (PPS) model. Instantaneous Frequency (IF) of the interference is obtained accurately by the method, and then an open-loop adaptive filter is employed to excise interference. Bit Error Rate (BER) of the DSSS system is greatly improved by the method.

articleTitle: Analysis of Antenna Mutual Coupling in the X-Type Polarization Diversity System
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Polarization diversity gain of the X-type polarization diversity system is determined by two factors: spatial correlation and average power ratio. These two factors are affected by mutual coupling (MC) greatly. Base on the polarization diversity antenna construction, a precise expression of MC, that is, mutual impedance is derived in this document. Combined with the equivalent MC network, the effects of MC on the spatial correlation and on the average power ratio are investigated firstly; next the effects of MC on the final polarization diversity gain through these two factors are further analyzed. Theoretical analysis plus numerical simulations are both presented. It is finally concluded that MC can raise the spatial correlation but also decrease the average power difference between the two array elements, thus changing the performance of polarization diversity system.

articleTitle: A Multi-Role Authorization Method Used in Heterogeneous Wireless Network
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Complex scenarios involving users' access in different administrative domains of wireless network do require a rather complete network access control mechanism. Thus, we propose an optimal solution where access network resources are based not only on simple access method to wireless network, but also on roles and attributes the end mobile user grants. To solve the problems of traditional centralized management and authorization mechanisms at present, we enhance this optimal solution, which is centralized in the identity authentication management and distributed in the access authorization management, and present new SAML-AVP type transmission message for this mechanism.

articleTitle: Correlative Coding Based Channel Estimation for Practical OFDM Systems over Time Varying Channels
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: OFDM systems encounter performance degradations in mobile environments due to inter-carrier interference (ICI) caused by Doppler spread. We find that previous studies using pilots to track the channel time variations always regard the ICI on pilots as additive white noise, which actually increases the estimation errors. As an enhancement of our previous studies on uneven pilot-assisted time-varying (TV) channel estimation (CE) for practical OFDM systems, to further improve the estimation precision, this paper employs the correlative coding to compress the ICI from data to pilots. Simulation results show that by using such a simple coding method, the ICI coefficient is reduced greatly and the estimation Mean Square Error (MSE) dropped by 3 dB. It is proved that the correlative code based TV CE method is feasible for practical mobile OFDM systems with good performance and bandwidth efficiency.

articleTitle: High-Speed FPGA Implementation for DWT of Lifting Scheme
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A new approach for Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) has been proposed recently under the name of lifting scheme. This scheme presents many advantages over the convolution-based approach. In this paper, a high speed 9/7 lifting DWT algorithm which is implementation on FPGA with multi-stage pipelining structure and rational 9/7 coefficients is presented. Compared with the architecture without multi-stage pipeline, the proposed architecture has higher operating frequency, the design raises operating frequency around 3 times more fast, at the expense of about 40% more hardware area. The hardware architecture is suitable for high speed implementation.

articleTitle: A Simplified Soft-Output QRD-M MIMO Detector
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, a low-complexity soft-output QRD-M detection algorithm is proposed for high-throughput multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems. By employing novel expansion on demand and distributed sorting scheme, the proposed algorithm can reduce 70% and 85% foundational operations for 16-QAM and 64-QAM respectively compared to the conventional QRD-M algorithm. Furthermore, the proposed algorithm can yield soft information to improve the bit error rate (BER) performance. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can achieve a near-ML detection performance with less foundational operations.

articleTitle: A Novel Intelligent Handoff Mechanism in the Heterogeneous Network Platform for Modern Service Industry
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to support the applications of modern service industry, it is indispensable to construct a heterogeneous network platform, which can provide open interfaces without consideration of the diversity of heterogeneous networks. In this paper, a novel system architecture based on network adaptation layer is given with corresponding modules. And then a capacity adaptation algorithm is proposed in capacity adaptation module to select the optimal network and terminal for users. A handoff algorithm is put forward in intelligent handoff module to implement seamless handoff process. Furthermore, a specific example based on stream media service is given in detail to illustrate the intelligent handoff mechanism, which is able to satisfy the requirements of the applications for modern service industry.

articleTitle: Transcoding of H.264 Bitstream to AVS Bitstream
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposes a transcoding scheme from H.264 to AVS. As the highest performance video coding standard, H.264 is developed by MPEG and ITU, AVS is developed by the Audio Video Coding Standard Working Group of China. The two standards will co-exist in the future application, therefore, it is worthy to transcode the video format from the H.264 to AVS and almost no complete research on this scheme until now. This paper proposes an effective transcoding method to achieve high efficient and fast transcoding without losing much quality by reusing intra mode, inter mode, motion vector and SAD, etc. Detailed experiment results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm can effectively reduce the transcoding complexity.

articleTitle: The Multi-Tenant Data Architecture Design for the Collaboration Service System of Textile & Apparel Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Multi-tenant technology is one of key competencies for software as a service (SaaS) to achieve higher profit margin by leveraging the economic scale. In China, there are a number of textile & apparel OEM enterprises, but due to the lower value-added products, they can not invest on information platform with very big budget. A collaboration service system supporting multiple tenants can significantly reduce cost of customization, deployment and operation of a great number of textile & apparel enterprises. This paper designs and implements a collaboration service system for textile & apparel supply chain. In this system, all tenants share the same infrastructure and application instance. However, from the user experience, the tenant would naturally dedicate to access and use the service as if there were dedicated ones. Therefore a cost-effective and secure multi-tenant infrastructure, especially in data access architecture, should be carefully considered. We analyze the key implementation patterns of data access multi-tenancy on aspects of isolation, security and customization. Furthermore the detailed access control flow is demonstrated.

articleTitle: A Revised One-Way Hash Based Low-Cost Authentication Protocol in RFID System
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Lightweight authentication protocols in the RFID system are necessary because the information security is important when messages are transmitted between the tag and reader. It has become one of the hottest issues in RFID system. Many researchers proposed some lightweight authentication protocols which only use lightweight operations, such as hash function, XOR operation and so on because the tags in RFID system are lack of computational resources, memory, power and communication ability. In this paper, we analyze the security of two different protocols based on the hash function and find their drawbacks. Afterwards, we propose a revised OHLCAP and analyze its property. The result indicates that this protocol dose not increase computational amount and tag's cost obviously. Meanwhile, it provides mutual authentication and untraceability and protects from desynchronization attack, impersonation attack and replay attack.

articleTitle: The Design of Mobile Target Monitoring System Based on VHF/TDMA Technology
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In view of moving features of city special vehicles, this paper proposed a way of building real-time mobile target monitoring system based on VHF wireless communication and TDMA multi-access technology. It designed the communication protocols of monitoring system referring the OSI module. A kind of special multi-serial port wireless communication controller is designed based on the 32-bit ARM microprocessor S3C44B0X and the embedded real-time operating system muC/OS-II. Finally, it designed a new wireless communication encryption algorithm named RRSE (real-time ring shift encipher) based on GPS.

articleTitle: Windowed All-Phase DFT Modulated in Time Domain and Its Application in Spectrum Analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Comparing with traditional DFT, windowed all-phase DFT (apDFT) possesses excellent property of restraining spectral leakage. However, based on analyzing the relationship between windowed apDFT and windowed DFT in theory, a half of information which can be obtained by windowed DFT is left out by windowed apDFT. So this paper holds that windowed apDFT has the excellent property of restraining spectral leakage at the cost of reducing spectral resolution of some certain frequency components. More importantly, to solve the problem, we present a novel approach called system of windowed all-phase DFT modulated in time domain (tmwapDFT). Finally, simulation results show that the approach has not only the excellent property of restraining spectral leakage, but also can compensate for the deficiency of windowed apDFT.

articleTitle: A Novel Energy Fairness Mechanism Based on Relay Selection for Cooperative MAC Protocol
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel energy fairness mechanism based on relay selection for cooperative MAC protocol. By changing the method of cooperation nodes selection, a round robin scheme is adopted to choose a relay node from all qualified nodes. The new mechanism improves the fairness of energy consumption of cooperation nodes, and studies the tradeoff between fairness of energy consumption and throughput performance. Theory analysis and simulation results prove that the proposed energy fairness mechanism can average the nodes energy consumption relatively and extend the system survival time with maintaining a certain system throughput.

articleTitle: Secure Route Selection Based on Trust Territories for Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Secure route selection is always a challenge for ad hoc networks. The paper applies trust theory into routing procedure in ad hoc networks and takes trust territories as one of routing metrics. Trust territories contain fours sets and describe different trust level. By considering trust territories, shorter and secure route is selected. Trust territories are discussed and the methods to build trust territories are given. The algorithms to compute trust value are also presented. Trust values and trust territories help to select a secure route and the trust territories are extended during routing. The malicious entities are found simultaneously.

articleTitle: Design of Mobile Server Framework in MANET
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The mobile ad-hoc network (MANET) is developing rapidly, and mobile servers are the trend of future network nodes. But it is still a problem to produce a suitable mobile server in the MANET. The challenges are from power saving, performance, portable requirements and so on. This paper presents a design of mobile server framework. It modularizes the server as replaceable units so that new technology can be easily deployed to fit the MANET environment. Especially, this paper introduces the messenger oriented P2P (MOP2P) framework. The theoretic analysis reveals that MOP2P in the MANET is more efficient than traditional end-to-end communication.

articleTitle: Iterative Channel Estimation Algorithm for OFDM Systems with Bit-Interleaving
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A new iterative channel estimation algorithm for orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) systems was proposed based on maximum-likelihood (ML) by using a specially designed training symbol.The proposed channel estimation utilizes the hard-decision information provided by the decoder of bit-interleaved coded modulation (BICM) to exchange the information between the channel estimator and the decoder. In BICM-OFDM systems, the simulation results show that the proposed algorithm not only reduces the number of the training symbols but also improves the accuracy of communication system comparing with conventional algorithms.

articleTitle: Research of Asynchronous Leader Election Algorithm on Hierarchy Ad Hoc Network
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Leader election is a very important problem, not only in wired networks, but in mobile ad hoc networks as well. However, due to the node mobility and network performance, cluster leader node may be lost which will affect the communication severely. According to the features of poor mobility of low-level node, in this paper, we present a low-level asynchronous algorithm with the collision avoidance mechanism, and solved the problem above. And we designed experiments in application layer. The leader-elected time was got from those experiments and the result was compared with synchronous algorithm. This algorithm can be used in fire fighting, construction supervision and rescue work in which a hierarchy ad hoc network is required to dynamically established. By electing a new leader in case of previous leader loss, the algorithm can enhance the robustness of whole network.

articleTitle: Beam Shaping for Satellite Phased Array Antenna Using Dual Coding Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A transmitting beam shaping scheme with limited amplitude weighted values for satellite active phased array antenna is presented to meet lower sidelobe and higher power amplifiers efficiency. The scheme is implemented by a dual coding genetic algorithm (GA) .Phase and amplitude of array weight vectors for shaped beam are encoded by real coding and finite length binary coding, which, maintaining accuracy of results, reduces the amplitude dynamic range and improves the efficiency of power amplifiers. The presented algorithm, compared to complex-coded GA, increases the convergence rate due to the search space's decrease. In order to overcome the prematurity and obtain better global optimization or quasi-global optimization, a new dual coding GA based on "species diversity retention" strategy and adaptive crossover and mutation probability is presented.

articleTitle: Design of BP-Based Decoding for Short LDPC Codes Using MMSE Criterion
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: By using the minimum mean square error (MMSE) criterion, we show the design of the scaled and offset belief propagation (BP)-based decoding for short low-density parity-check (LDPC) codes on the channels of additive white Gaussian noise (AWGN) and uncorrelated flat Rayleigh fading with side information (SI). Based on the MMSE criterion, the detailed derivations and numerical calculations on the optimum factors for these two improved BP-based algorithms are provided. The simulation results for several short (3,6) regular LDPC codes on the AWGN and Rayleigh fading channels demonstrate that the scaled and offset BP-based algorithms with our proposed factors can achieve the performance almost the same to, and even better than that of the BP algorithm.

articleTitle: A Password-Authenticated Key Agreement Scheme for Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A password-authenticated key agreement scheme based on elliptic curves cryptography (ECC) for ad hoc networks is presented. The scheme is composed of system initialization, identity-based (ID-based) password evolvement algorithm, identity authentication algorithm and session keys generation algorithm. The freshness and security of password are guaranteed by the sharing password evolvement mechanism every time in node's identity authentication. The self-certified key is used in the scheme to guarantee the reliability of the node's identity and reduce requirement for data storage and traffic. The scheme combines password authentication with public key authentication and enjoys many secure properties such as forward security, backward security, key independence, etc. So that it can resist types of attack. The computation complexity and the communication overhead of the scheme are low. The scheme is independent of any group controller and is suitable for ad hoc networks.

articleTitle: An Efficient Relay Selection Strategy for High Speed Users in Cooperative Diversity Systems
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Cooperative diversity has been proposed to form virtual antenna arrays in order to obtain spatial diversity gains. Various relay selection strategies in cooperative diversity systems were proposed but they are efficient for static or low speed users. An efficient relay selection strategy for systems with high speed users is presented in this paper by dividing users into three groups according to their moving speeds and directions. The relays for cooperation are selected from the same group with the source user. Simulation results show that the proposed strategy can increase duration of cooperation, as well as decrease the partner handoff times and probability of unsuccessful partner selection, and the same energy gain can be obtained.

articleTitle: Variable Precision Rough Set Weight Calculation Based on Web Text Classification
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Rough set is a popular theoretical method recently, it could process expression, study and induction of uncertainty or incomplete knowledge and data. According to rough set theory and variable precision rough set model to analyze disadvantages of widely used inverse texts frequency weighting method, and proposed to use variable precision rough set model to establish weight type of feature word weight and a new weight calculation method of double weighting. Experimental conclusions show that the calculation method is valuable in use.

articleTitle: Phased-Array Radar Beam Tracking and Predicting
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The appearance of phased-array radar brought new challenges to electronic countermeasure. By analyzing the characteristic of phased-array radar, this paper puts forward a countercheck using beam scanning information basing on distributed electric countermeasure, and puts forward an tracking and predicting algorithm apply to "TWS" mode.

articleTitle: An Enhanced Energy Detection Algorithm in Cognitive Radio
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: As the rapid growth of wireless technologies, current spectrum scarcity has become a serious problem as more and more wireless applications compete for very little spectrum. On the other hand, some licensed bands allocated to applications such as TV services show little usage. Then, to improve the utilization of radio spectrum, cognitive radio technology has been proposed, so that devices can sense and use idle bands dynamically by autonomous detection. This paper mainly introduce an enhanced energy detection algorithm based on some usual methods for detecting signals embedded in noise, and then give the simulation results.

articleTitle: Spectrum Sensing Based on Covariance Matrix under Noise Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Energy detection based collaborative spectrum sensing algorithm is recently studied widely for primary signals detection in cognitive radio. However, one major disadvantage of those detectors is that their performance degrades in the presence of noise uncertainty which is inevitable in practical system. In this paper, we introduce a novel statistical covariance matrix based collaborative spectrum sensing algorithm which, confirmed by simulations, can perform better than traditional energy fusion algorithm when noise uncertainty exists. In addition, the decision threshold can be easily obtained through theoretical computing whether the received noise samples at cognitive users are correlated or not.

articleTitle: Research on a Improved Reliable Multicast Protocol in HF Data Communication
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the features of HF data communication, an improved multicast protocol derived from RMTP (reliable multicast transport protocol) for HF reliable multicast transportation is provided. Since RMTP is not fitted for HF communication, the concept of "transmission in one layer; more layers support; and feedback in different layers on different time" is provided, some modifications are made to make it suitable for our HF communication scenarios. Simulation results indicate that, this improved protocol provided by this paper could meet with our demand, while reducing the transmitting delay for reliable multicast.

articleTitle: A Frame Bit Allocation Algorithm in Mobile P2P Overlay Network
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Firstly, after super-unstructured P2P architecture introduced some super-peers controlled by operation business, a mobile P2P architecture was proposed for streaming media system. And then in this architecture, a receiver-driven bit allocation algorithm was proposed. This algorithm firstly divided the video sequence into a series of blocks where there was the fixed number of frames, and then assigned all bits in block level to consider the frame interaction. For the bits allocation problem of each block, it was modeled as a nonlinear programming problem. After the piece linear R-D model was introduced and some constraint conditions were relaxed, it was further transformed into a general linear programming problem. The experiment results show our algorithm had the high and smooth quality and its time complexity is lower, which can meet with the real time requirement of mobile P2P video streaming media system, his electronic document is a "live" template. The various components of your paper [title, text, heads, etc.] are already defined on the style sheet, as illustrated by the portions given in this document.

articleTitle: The Realization of High Precision Frequency Measurement System Based on Wet Steam Wetness Measurement System
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: According to the characteristic that the resonant frequency of the resonant cavity shifts with the change of the air permittivity, this paper presents the frequency measurement system based on the microwave cavity wetness measurement system and realizes the accurate measurement of the steam wetness. A new method of frequency measurement is introduced, which is the combination of multi-cycle synchronization and quantization delay. The measurement resolution reaches to be 0.1 Hz, satisfying the requirement of wetness measurement system. The hardware schematic diagram which is realized with CPLD is given. The design has high speed, high precision and wide frequency range measurement with high integration and strong reliability.

articleTitle: A Design Method to Acquire High Gain for Omni-Direction Radiation Applied in WiMAX
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposed a novel design method to acquire high gain for coaxial collinear sleeve dipole array antenna. Based on the analysis of S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">21</sub> of one element and two elements of the antenna, the current magnitude and phase on each element distribute equally. Thus high gain and good omnidirectional performance on the horizontal plane is obtained with the equilibrium of the energy on each element. Details of the proposed antenna design are described, and experimental results for the VSWR and gain are presented. The measured VSWR <2, bandwidth is to 11.5%. The un-roundness is about plusmn0.3 dB on horizontal plane and the least gain is 6.4 dB from 3.4 to 3.6 GHz, covering the WiMAX band.

articleTitle: Serially Concatenated Turbo Codes
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The paper presents a new scheme of concatenated codes, referred to as serially concatenated turbo (SCT) codes. The code is constructed as the serial combinations of two turbo codes, i.e. turbo recursive systematic convolutional (RSC) codes and turbo Bose Ray Chaudhuri Hocquenghem (BCH) codes, linked by a pseudo-random interleaver. In comparison with the conventional turbo RSC codes, SCT codes have higher minimum distance values. Based on conducted simulations, it is found that SCT codes outperform turbo RSC codes at the waterfall and error floor regions, while they require reasonable number of iterations at their iterative decoding structure to achieve good performance.

articleTitle: A 900-mV Area-Efficient Source-Degenerated CMOS Four-Quadrant Multiplier with 10.6-GHz Bandwidth
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents a low-voltage area-efficient four-quadrant CMOS multiplier reconfigured in a source-degenerated topology and designed as a part of a correlator for an integrated ultra-wideband (UWB) transceiver. The simulation based on a 0.18-mum CMOS technology shows that the multiplier offers 10.6-GHz bandwidth while dissipating 290 muA from a 0.9-V supply.

articleTitle: A Differentiated Shared Path Protection Algorithm in WDM Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The capacity of optical network increases sharply as the development of WDM technology, and reliability turns into a important issue; How to provide differentiated service to meet different requirements of customers is the development objective of optical network which data service is being the mainstream today. This paper addresses shared-path protection design problem with differentiated reliability. Based on FIR, make it possess the characteristic of load balance through weighting design, and bring in the concept of differentiated reliability (DiR) to have it provide different reliability level services to different customers. Simulation result shows this algorithm not only efficiently satisfies the user-specific requirement, but also effectively decreases the network-blocking ratio.

articleTitle: The Implementation of 16QAM Modulation and Demodulation and Performance Comparison
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The paper deals with the principle of 16 QAM modulation and demodulation of high data rate-to-bandwidth ratio,and the BER in the transmission of 16 QAM modulation, BPSK modulation and QPSK modulation was compared with simulation by MATLAB. The experiment proves that 16 QAM modulation and demodulation is not only easy to achieve but also better to perform.

articleTitle: A Self-Adaptive Clustering Algorithm for Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The network routing could be simplified by clustering algorithm in wireless sensor network (WSN). Aimed at the occasion with a large amount of nodes but without whole-network time synchronization mechanism, a self-adaptive clustering algorithm for network topology control is proposed. In this algorithm, the cluster structure can be adjusted automatically according to the nodes distribution and network traffic. By adopting loop-avoidance mechanism, the correctness of routing selection is ensured when adjusting the cluster structure. The simulation results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm can reach the expected effect of self-adjustment.

articleTitle: Hybrid Detector Based Negative Selection Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A new algorithm of detector generation for negative selection algorithm is introduced by adding a big detector to reach a high coverage of non-self space. While the big detector can be variable in different shape using this concept, the paper puts forward an algorithm using a ring-hyper-sphere shaped detector as a big detector. The algorithm is tested using different self set (or training set) and real-word dataset. Preliminary results demonstrate that the new approach enhances the negative selection algorithm in efficiency and reliability without significant increase in complexity.

articleTitle: A RF-IPS Algorithm for Peer-to-Peer Video-on-Demand System
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents an improved piece selection algorithm called RF-IPS algorithm, by analyzing the running mode of peer-to-peer (P2P) video-on-demand (VOD) systems and doing some research on a few piece selection algorithms which have been proposed in the past. The characteristic of our proposal is that we proposed "interval" based on the RF algorithm. Based on the chief feature of P2P VOD system, we partitioned the buffer into three intervals, the pieces in which we got through three different downloading strategies respectively. We carry through contrast experiments on piece selection algorithms by using five different strategies at the same conditions, and the results show our algorithm is efficient. Overall, we believe that the RF-IPS algorithm is feasible to further improve system performance and provide a cost-effective P2P VOD service with acceptable user experience.

articleTitle: Study on Design and Application of Wireless Sensor Network Based on Communication of Radio Frequency Identification System
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Wireless sensor network(WSN) integrated with existing radio frequency identification application(RFED) can not only capture information of items in the container, but also sense the condition around the items by wireless communication. Based on technology infrastructure of items management with RFID, assimilating the thinking of IEEE 1451 transducer electronic data sheet(TEDS), the paper designs hardware and software of sensing tag and reader, and brings forward infrastructure and information processes of WSN based on communication of active RFID, and analyses the application case of container shipping with WSN system designed.

articleTitle: Improved Data Fusion Model for Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: For the characteristics of wireless sensor networks, combined the knowledge discover theory of data mining and knowledge application theory of data fusion, to set a unique integrated information treatment model based on neural-network based aggregation. The model is effective on saving wireless sensor energy consumption, extends net life, and is applicable to a variety of wireless sensor networks.

articleTitle: Cluster Based Dynamic Routing on Powerline Carrier Network
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Topology of power line carrier network (PLCN) is complex, fast changeable and its channel is time-variant. To enhance the availability and effectiveness of network communication, a cluster based dynamic routing algorithm (CBDR) is proposed in the paper. The algorithm adopts clustering based on root tree and local traversal in order to construct and maintain the dynamic routes according to trees topology, uncertain nodes and the characteristics of power line carrier network, it also adjusts effective communication distance to simplify route. The simulation shows that CBDR using in PLCN is available, it reduces network construction time and maintains the routes effectively. It makes routes of PLCN stabile and flexible. At last the conclusion is made for the further study.

articleTitle: Outage Probability of Space-Time Coded Decouple-and-Forward Relaying over Nakagami-m Fading Channels
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, the outage probability of space-time coded decouple-and-forward (DCF) relay network in Nakagami-m fading channels is analyzed. We derive both accurate expressions and closed-form bounds of outage probability by investigating the statistic property of sum of Gamma random variables. All the analytical results are confirmed through Monte Carlo simulations.

articleTitle: A Self Adjustable Multi-Channel MAC Protocol for Ad Hoc Wireless Network
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we propose a new multi-channel MAC protocol for MHs that are equipped with single transceiver or multi-transceivers in ad hoc wireless network. The proposed protocol modified the RTS/CTS frames for multi-channel usage, and divides the transmission frame into channel negotiation and data transmission period. The protocol can contain different type of MHs including multi-channel and single channel nodes and achieve high throughput. The simulation results show that our schemes can effectively exploit multiple channels to achieve higher throughput than IEEE 802.11 and many existing multi-channel MAC protocols.

articleTitle: Mashup-Based Web Page Adaptation for Small Screen Mobile Device
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: It is a challenging problem to integrate massive information from a normal web page, which is designed for PCs, to display on mobile handheld device with small screen, poor user interface and limited hardware ability. By referring to mashup concept, a new web page adaptation scheme for mobile device is proposed: firstly, a original web page is split into many small blocks which are suitable for displaying on mobile device; subsequently, the blocks are classified by analyzing layered iterative relationship between these blocks on horizontal and vertical direction; moreover, web service APIs are provided so that mobile terminal users or third-party service providers can mashup the page blocks swiftly and conveniently, establishing new personalized and various mobile web applications; finally, the proposed scheme is put into practice as a prototype, which verifies the scheme and shows its values in both technical and economical viewpoints.

articleTitle: VCG Auction Based Hierarchical Bandwidth Sharing Scheme for Integrated Heterogeneous Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Bandwidth resource management is an important issue in integrated heterogeneous wireless networks. In this paper, we propose a two-level bandwidth sharing scheme in integrated WiMAX, UMTS and WLAN networks. Based on Vickrey-Clarke-Groves (VCG) auction theory, this hierarchical integrated structure aims to optimize the reallocation of unused bandwidth in primary network (PN), and to provide secondary network (SN) with quality guaranteed service. In order to further enhance the rationality in bandwidth allocation, a novel pricing scheme is adopted in VCG mechanism. In our proposed model, WiMAX and UMTS serve the WLAN AP as backbone, sharing their licensed spectrum with WLANs as double auction. Based on the bandwidth allocation result, admission control among WLAN connections is launched as a manner of second-price sealed-bid auction. Simulation results prove the proposed scheme could significantly improve the utility of PNs' spectrum, and bring better services for WLAN users.

articleTitle: Simple and Efficient Cross-Correlation Method for Estimating 2-D Direction of Arrival
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Inspired by the recent work of Tayem and Kwon, who developed a fast algorithm for estimating 2-D DOAs using the propagator method (PM) of the L-shape array (PMLA). Although PMLA is efficient, like all other PM based methods, its performance is slightly inferior to the subspace based methods in terms of estimation accuracy and the number of estimated sources. Moreover, the correlation information between the L-shape subarray sensors is not fully utilized. This motivates us to develop a subspace-based method by exploiting the L-shape array geometry and the cross-correlation information among sensor data. Benefits of the proposed method include improved performance, and reduction of the computationally burden further. Simulation results are presented to demonstrate the effectiveness and validation of advantages of the proposed method in comparison to PMLA and other estimation algorithms.

articleTitle: A Heuristic Reduced Complexity Computing Method for Multi-Cell Joint Channel Estimation in B3G TDD System
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: For the concerned TD-SCDMA and its LTE cellular mobile radio system introduced in this paper, there are already some useful algorithms concerning multi-user detection to eliminate inter-symbol interference (ISI) and multiple-access interference (MAI). Since only home cell multiple users are included, those algorithms can only combat ISI and MAI between home cell users. Interferences from users of neighbor cells are treated as white noise. When planning network deployment by assigning same frequency band to all cells, which is a merit for TDD system to increase efficiency and capacity, strong intercell interferences occur and the overall performance deteriorates rapidly. To solve this problem, we introduce this new multicell detection algorithm and show its benefit. Essentially, the complexity of the new algorithm will increase tremendously. So we also give an efficient simplifying method for it to be practical without imposing hard requirement to the original hardware platform. Simulation results also show that the new algorithm is effective and satisfying.

IEEE Keywords: Time division synchronous code division multiple access

articleTitle: Temporal Segmentation Based on Video Coding
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: We present an overview of the state of the art of segmentation based video coding aimed at low-bit rate application. The most significant contribution is the algorithm for the segmentation of videoconference image sequences for content-based coding. The segmentation is based on motion estimation trough the computation of the optical flow field and motion segmentation by applying a graph-theoretical clustering. The algorithm will be added to the video codes of the Open H323 project which is based on H.323 ITU-T Recommendation. This visual collaboration environment for Desktop, composed of terminals, gatekeepers and MCU(multipoint control unit), has already been implemented and tested. It is particularly convenient for academics implementation, the software is freely distributed, and its code can be modified according to the needs of the user.

articleTitle: Adaptive Discovery of Internet Gateways in Mobile Ad Hoc Networks: With Mobile IP-Based Internet Connectivity
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: When MANET is connected to the Internet, it is important for the mobile nodes to detect an available gateway providing an access to the Internet. This paper introduces an Internet access scheme for MANET by using mobile IP. This scheme provides a dynamic gateway algorithm to calculate an optimal gateway of the MANET and automatically handover to another gateway while the mobile gateway in use becomes unavailable, such as power off. The implement result shows that our scheme achieves good connectivity even when the specified mobile gateway leaves MANET. NS2 simulation indicates overhead of our scheme has been greatly reduced compared with the pure protocol.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Compensation Support Vector Classification for Direction of Arrival Estimation
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents a new direction of arrival (DOA) estimation method based on a multi-class implementation of fuzzy compensation support vector machine (SVM). The proposed method can achieve higher accurate estimates for DOA while avoiding the all-direction peak value searching technique used in other traditional DOA estimation methods. Meanwhile, compared with other SVM-based DOA estimation, like LS-SVM algorithm, this approach reduces the training and testing time and performs better with larger data, so is easier to implement in real-time applications. Computer simulation results show the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Weak Signal Detection Based on Signal-Correlation Principle
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The weak signal embedded in various noises is the subject of weak signal detection, while the noises much stronger than the valuable signal, and must take measures to improve the S/N during measuring the signal. So based on the signal-correlation principle, separates the useful signal from the noises by the measured-method of signal-correlation principle.

articleTitle: The Research in Improving the Quality of DW Data: The Job-Scheduling and Checking Based Program in Upgrading DW Performance
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: ETL is an important segment to build an accurate data warehouse. The improvements of the quality in the data warehouse help to guarantee the reliability and help the enterprise to summarize and use the data for a long period of time. There are many methods to improve the quality of data. The paper mainly focused on the ETL dispatcher and the way of checking to improve data quality of data warehouse. And the experiment on EMC projects had proved that it could improve data quality of DW effectively.

articleTitle: Multiuser Detection Using the Novel Particle Swarm Optimization with Simulated Annealing
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: To resolve local convergence problem of the standard discrete particle swarm optimization algorithm, a novel particle swarm optimization algorithm (NPSO) that using new move equations is presented. Based on the simulated annealing and the NPSO, a simulated annealing particle swarm optimization (SAPSO) is proposed to solve multiuser detection problem of code division multiple access (CDMA) systems. By hybridizing the simulated annealing, the NPSO and the Hopfield neural network, the new algorithm can search global optimal solution in faster convergence rate. Simulation results for synchronous and asynchronous case are provided to show that the designed detector is superior to the conventional detector and some previous detectors in bit error rate (BER), multiple access interference and near-far resistance.

articleTitle: Proxy-Based Object Packaging and Compression: A Web Acceleration Scheme for UMTS
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: 3G mobile communication networks such as UMTS provide wide area Web access. However, Web latency is usually beyond users' tolerable waiting time even in wired networks. In UMTS networks, mainly due to large RTTs and limitations of existing HTTP, Web latency increases dramatically. In this paper, we introduce a Web acceleration scheme, proxy-based object packaging and compression (POPC), for reducing Web latency in UMTS networks. POPC, implemented based on proxy, combines both WAN optimization and application acceleration techniques. Simulation results show that packaging can reduce latency by 50% and compression by 20% more.

articleTitle: Distortion-Compensation Scheme for PAPR Reduction of OFDM Signals
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A distortion-compensation scheme is proposed for the PAPR reduction of orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) signal. In the transmitter, clipping the peak envelope of the input signal to a predetermined value will cause in-band distortion. This distortion is encoded as clipping information and transmitted in the next block. In the receiver, the in-band distortion is compensated by the clipping information. The proposed scheme can achieve the same PAPR reduction effect as the conventional clipping scheme without seriously degradation of BER performance, at the cost of slightly spectral efficiency loss.

articleTitle: A Fuzzy Logic Based QoS Evaluation Model for Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Quality of service (QoS) in wireless sensor network (WSN) presents a great challenge to researchers, and work in this area has been isolated and focused on some specific protocol layers or application scenarios. In this paper, we propose a holistic QoS model to evaluate the performance of WSN. QoS requirements within a WSN reference architecture is presented, and then a two-way mapping between application layer parameters and network layer parameters is carefully analyzed using fuzzy logic. Finally, we propose a fuzzy logic based comprehensive evaluation model for systematic QoS in WSN, and use a case study to illustrate its effectiveness.

articleTitle: EMD-Based Denoising of UWB-IR Signal
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The empirical mode decomposition (EMD) applied to analysis of nonstationary and nonlinear signals has attracted great research interests. In this paper, a novel adaptive approach based on EMD framework is introduced to remove noise from ultrawideband impulse radio (UWB-IR) signals. Specifically, the noisy UWB-IR signal is decomposed into a finite number of oscillatory modes known as intrinsic mode functions (IMFs) and a residue. Due to different correlation characteristics of signal and noise in IMF domain, significant features of signal are improved when noise is suppressed by multiplying adjacent IMF components directly. By comparing values of original IMF with results of correlation, signal points are extracted resulting in removing noise. The proposed denoising approach is complemented by numerical examples to illustrate the efficient elimination of noise on UWB-IR signal and to demonstrate the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) improvement induced by this approach as a performance criterion.

articleTitle: Cost Function of Features Based Mode Switching Algorithm for Indoor Positioning
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposed a cost function of features based mode switching algorithm for indoor positioning to solve the problem of choosing the best positioning mode in the overlapping area. The experiments show that when the precisions of the alternative location modes are of no big difference, using this algorithm is much more reasonable.

articleTitle: The Research of NIDS Based on Improved GA
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: To settle the problems in existing intrusion detection systems, this paper researches the application of genetic algorithms in intrusion detection system, discusses the fitness function structure, and improves population choice and selection operator and crossover operator and mutation operator. We propose an intrusion detection model based on improved genetic algorithm and proves it's feasible by experiments.

articleTitle: The Implementing of Software Configuration Management Based on CMM
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper introduces the design and implementing scheme of SCM that one software organization may adopt, discusses the basic concepts of SCM, putting forward the implement of configuration management based on CMMI and putting the stress on the practices of configuration identifier, version control and change control. Next presents a software development platform integrated software configuration management capabilities. By the introduction of document management and code management module, so that the whole process of software development can management by them, so that the whole process of software development can by management by the configuration management norm, to achieve the purpose of improvement the quality efficiency of development.

articleTitle: A Cooperative Vertical Handover Algorithm in Integrated Wireless and Mobile Network
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The increasing demand for broadband service, especially in some hot spot areas, requires the network operator integrate different kind of radio access technology (RAT). In order to provide seamless service among the RATs, a vertical handover algorithm is needed. In this paper, we present a cooperative vertical handover algorithm which considers not only the QoS factors but also the signaling cost and the load balance. The QoS information is gathered by the mobile terminal and the grey relational coefficient (GRC) of the QoS part is calculated. After receiving the information from the mobile terminal, the network side estimates the velocity of the mobile terminal and checks the load of different RATs. Finally, handover decision is made according to the GRC of the different RATs.

articleTitle: Network Security Situation Generation and Evaluation Based on Heterogeneous Sensor Fusion
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Network Security Situation Awareness (NSSA) is an emerging technique in the field of network security and it helps security analysts to be aware of the actual security situation of their networks. In this paper we presented a novel NSSA model based on multi-sensor data fusion. In our model, we acquired data from heterogeneous sensors and fused them employing Multi-Layer Feed-forward Neural Network in combination with efficient feature reduction approach which improved real-time nature of the fusion engine. Furthermore, we discussed the security situation awareness generation techniques and evaluation indicators detailedly. Our model is proved to be feasible and effective through a series of experiments.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of MIMO MRC Systems
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, the performance of multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) maximal ratio combining (MRC) systems is investigated. We first propose the exact closed-form expressions for the bit error rate (BER) of Gray mapping M-PAM, M-QAM, BPSK and QPSK. Next, we derive approximate BER expression for Gray mapping M-PSK (M=S8) constellations. Finally, the validity of the performance analysis is demonstrated by the computer simulations.

articleTitle: Topology Controlling for QoS in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Energy limitation is one of the most important characters in Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs). Using energy efficiently is significant to prolong sensor network lifetime. The more repeated overlay is, the more energy is wasted. If we divide the nodes into some independent subsets and alternatively awake these subsets, the node energy is consumed slowly. However, the requirement of QoS is opposite to the energy. To solve this problem, the relationship between the desired QoS requirement and the minimum number of active nodes is analyzed in the randomly deployed sensor networks. We propose a Topology Controlling QoS (TCQS) Protocol for wireless sensor networks based on our analytical results. According to the energy and previous working status, our scheme selects the minimum number of active nodes without using any location information. Simulation results show that TCQS can not only reduce the energy consumption of nodes and increase the network lifetime, but also balance the energy consumption among nodes.

articleTitle: Adaptive Order-Decision Method for Memory Polynomial Based Predistorters
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: To predistort a power amplifier's nonlinearity with memory effects, various predistorters with memory are proposed. Among them, the memory polynomial (MP)-based predistorter attracts more attentions due to its low complexity and good performance. The nonlinearity order and memory order, as two key parameters of a MP-based predistorter, have great effect on the linearization performance. In this paper, a low complexity order-decision approach is proposed to find the optimal nonlinearity and memory order for MP-based predistorters. The proposed approach can make a predistorter fit for different PAs. This makes a predistorter more intelligent and universal. Finally, the proposed approach is verified by simulations and experiments.

articleTitle: Triangular Memory Polynomial Predistorter
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: To predistort a power amplifier nonlinear with memory effects, a triangular memory polynomial (TMP) predistorter is presented based on the traditional memory polynomial predistorter. The coefficients of the predistorter can be directly extracted from an offline system identification process using an open-loop structure. This reduces the implementation complexity of the system. Experimental results show that the adjacent channel power ratio is improved more than 13 dB by utilizing the proposed predistorter. Compared with a traditional memory polynomial predistorter, the proposed TMP predistorter can reduce the number of coefficients efficiently(66% or more).

articleTitle: A Game Theory Based WiMAX Uplink Power Control Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The power control is a crucial technology in wireless communication. IEEE 802.16 protocol suggests that WiMAX system should adopt power control technology on the uplink channel, and requires its performance, which will ensure the quality of communications and suppress the co-channel interference. However, the exact algorithm is vendor-specific. In this paper, the game theory was applied to WiMAX uplink power control. All co-channel users were game participants, and their uplink power was used as a strategy to achieve Nash equilibrium. The simulation results show that this algorithm can control uplink power and ensure communications quality, at the same time, the pricing factor lambda will affect the convergence speed and convergence power of algorithm.

articleTitle: Combined Fountain Code with Network Coding for Error-Tolerant Transmission Network
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Network coding can achieve the maximum possible rate defined by the max-flow min-cut theorem through encoding of the input streams at the correlative nodes under the ideal channel condition. When error happens, encoding will bring in error propagation. By introducing redundancies in space domain, network error correction is proposed, however, with the high encoding and decoding complexity. Specifically, fountain code is a rateless code, since the rate varies according to the instant channel state information contrast to the typical fixed-rate code. Based on the fountain code, the error-tolerant network coding scheme is proposed by means of integrating fountain code with network coding at the correlative nodes. Simulation results show that the proposed scheme can obtain the lower block error rate (BLER) in butterfly and wireless network, compared with detect and forward scheme. Furthermore, it also reduces the energy consumption at the same time.

articleTitle: Optimal Prefix Cache Allocation among Multiple Cooperative Local Proxies
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper investigates the cache allocation of videos' prefix among multiple proxies. For heterogeneous videos with different lengths, rates, and popularities and heterogeneous proxies with different storage capacities constraints, a heuristic cache allocation algorithm is proposed to minimize remote server use and load balance among multiple proxies. Simulation results verify the effectiveness of our proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Location-Based Services to Control Roller Compaction Quality for Rock-Fill Dams
publicationTitle: 2009 5th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: It is very important for rock-fill dams to carry out more accurately monitoring and remotely quality controlling in real time. Based on location based services, an integration platform, with the name of CRCQ-DAM, is proposed to control roller compaction quality for rock-fill dam, which can meet the needs of real-time and accuracy about the roller compaction quality. An example of application research is experimented in Pubugou hydropower station, which is the largest rock-fill dam of China at present.
